verses.text: Anhejton t'a Dios tz'ilchaj junk'olal wu'uj. Ha t'ay skot in kolnab'il.
Anhej tzin kolaneli, a tz'ochpax wenhulok. Malaj b'ak'inh ol in ak'jok ganar yujto ha' ayoch in kolnab'ilok.
¿B'ak'inh ol eyaktej eyoch b'ulan t'ayin yik ol in he tek'ankanem eyalani? Ichato toxo wal tzin telwi icha junok pat k'axo, ma icha junok makte' toxo tzek' leknajok.
Haxonhej tas tz'aj yixtaxel in b'inajnakil tze na'ub'tanhej. E k'inalxonhej he na'ank'e es. Tze tz'ak eyal wach' lolonel t'ayin, palta haxo t'a he pensar, tzin he katab'ej.
Anhej t'a Dios tz'ilchaj junk'olal wu'uj. Anhej ayoch yipok in k'o'ol.
Anhej tzin kolaneli, tz'ochpax wenhulok. Manh ol in telwoklaj. A' ayoch in kolnab'ilok.
Ha t'a Dios skot in kolnab'il, yuj chi' ay welk'ochi. A' ayoch wenhulok yet' in kolnab'ilok.
Ex wetchonhab', anhej Dios tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol. T'a smasanil he k'o'ol, tzex lesalwi t'ay, yujto a ko kolnab'il yaji.

Ha heb' anima, junelnhej malaj jab'ok yelk'och heb', wach'chom meb'a' heb', ma b'eyum heb'. K'inalok tz'echtaj yalil heb' t'a junok echlab' smasanil, toton max cheklajlaj jab'ok yalil heb' chi', yuj chi' manh kak'ek ochlaj ko pensar t'a heb'.
Manh eyak'och ixtoj anima, ma elk'al yipok he k'o'ol. Tato tzex och b'eyumal, manh eyak'och he b'eyumal chi' yipok he k'o'ol.

Manh jantakok wab'an yalchaji to ha Dios aljinakkan icha tik: Ha in Dios Yajal in tik, masanil syal wu'uj, aynhej pax in wach'k'olal. Tzin paktzitej t'a junjun anima icha syal tas tz'el sk'ulani, xchi Dios.
